pairs.en: 3.2.1 Connection with Graph-based Learning. The embedding propagation is equivalent to the graph convolutional network (GCN). To show the relation, let us first construct a graph based on the stock relation encodings At , where vertices represent stocks and edges connect vertices with at least one relation, i.e., we connect vertex i and j if they satisfy the condition sum(aij) > 0. If we represent the graph with an adjacency matrix A and normalize it by column, the Uniform Embedding Propagation (i.e., Equation 10) has exactly the same effect as the state-of-the-art graph convolutional operation (i.e., f (F, X) = AX; details see Section 2.2.1). However, GCN cannot capture the temporal evolution properties as designed in our TGC, since the adjacency matrix A has to be fixed in GCN. As such, our proposed operation can be seen as generalizing the GCN by specifically modeling the temporal patterns, thus we term it as the Temporal Graph Convolution

pairs.en: The embedding propagation is equivalent to the graph convolutional network (GCN). To show the relation, let us first construct a graph based on the stock relation encodings At , where vertices represent stocks and edges connect vertices with at least one relation, i.e., we connect vertex i and j if they satisfy the condition sum(aij) > 0. If we represent the graph with an adjacency matrix A and normalize it by column, the Uniform Embedding Propagation (i.e., Equation 10) has exactly the same effect as the state-of-the-art graph convolutional operation (i.e., f (F, X) = AX; details see Section 2.2.1). However, GCN cannot capture the temporal evolution properties as designed in our TGC, since the adjacency matrix A has to be fixed in GCN. As such, our proposed operation can be seen as generalizing the GCN by specifically modeling the temporal patterns, thus we term it as the Temporal Graph Convolution.
pairs.zh: 嵌入传播等价于图卷积网络（GCN）。为了显示关系，让我们首先基于股票关系编码At构建一个图，其中顶点表示股票，边连接具有至少一个关系的顶点，即，如果顶点i和j满足条件sum（aij）> 0，则连接它们。如果我们用邻接矩阵A表示图并按列对其进行归一化，均匀嵌入传播（即，等式10）具有与现有技术的图卷积运算完全相同的效果（即，f（F，X）= AX;细节参见第2.2.1节）。然而，GCN不能捕获如在我们的TGC中设计的时间演化属性，因为邻接矩阵A必须在GCN中固定。因此，我们所提出的操作可以被看作是通过专门建模时间模式来推广GCN，因此我们将其称为时间图卷积。

pairs.en: We use inner product to estimate the similarity, inspired by its effectiveness in modeling the similarity (interaction) between two entities (embeddings) in Collaborative Filtering [ 15]. The second term is a nonlinear regression model on the relations, where each element in w denotes the weight of a relation in general and b is a bias term. Since both terms of this function are directly interpretable, we call it as Explicit Modeling.
pairs.zh: 我们使用内积来估计相似性，灵感来自它在协同过滤[15]中建模两个实体（嵌入）之间的相似性（交互）的有效性。第二项是关系的非线性回归模型，其中w中的每个元素一般表示关系的权重，b是偏差项。由于该函数的两个项都是可直接解释的，我们称之为显式建模。

pairs.en: The second term is pair-wise max-margin loss [45], which encourages the predicted ranking scores of a stock pair to have the same relative order as the ground-truth. The similar max-margin loss has been used in several applications such as recommendation [38 ] and knowledge based completion [ 34] and demonstrated good performance in ranking tasks. Minimizing our proposed combined loss will force the prediction ranking scores to be close to both 1) the return ratios of stocks in terms of absolute values, and 2) the relative orders of return ratios among stocks, so as to facilitate investors making better investment decisions. On one hand, correct relative order of stocks could help to select the investment targets (i.e., the top ranked stocks). On the other hand, the accurate prediction of return ratio would facilitate deciding the timing of investment since the top ranked stocks are valuable targets only when the return ratios would largely increase.
pairs.zh: 第二项是成对最大边际损失[45]，这鼓励股票对的预测排名得分具有与地面事实相同的相对顺序。类似的最大利润损失已用于几个应用中，例如推荐[38 ]和基于知识的完成[ 34]并在排名任务中表现出良好的性能。最小化我们提出的组合损失将迫使预测排名得分接近1）股票收益率的绝对值; 2）股票收益率的相对排序，以帮助投资者做出更好的投资决策。一方面，正确的股票相对排序有助于选择投资目标另一方面，对回报率的准确预测将有助于决定投资时机，因为只有当回报率大幅增加时，排名靠前的股票才是有价值的目标。
